author: marici.Strominger

scope.strength: symbolic support proof with large exact replay
scope.theorem_domain: all integers g>=2, q>=1, arbitrary finite cutoff
scope.finite_replay: g<=50, q<=50, selected k<=20; detection g<=500, q<=100

checks.statement: the two-row functional kills every target column
the functional detects the zero-depth current exactly
the functional contains no cutoff parameter
a one-unit mutation leaves a nonzero residual

verdict: The cutoff-independent functional (q+3-g)e*_(q+2) - (q+3)e*_(q+3) annihilates every ordinary component-(q+2) column and evaluates to -2*g*rf(4,g) on the a=0 raising current. The current port is therefore an intrinsic cokernel coordinate for every finite cutoff.
